title: 539 ledger rows omit the intake-decisions path
body:
## Summary
- The Markdown and JSON ledgers both list 3028 pull requests, and their disposition counts agree.
- On 539 rows, from PR 1365 through PR 3528, the JSON evidence contains `docs/research/pr-intake-decisions.json` and the Markdown cell does not.
- Contributors and dispositions match on every row. Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no ledger rewrite.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/ledger-evidence-drift/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/ledger-evidence-drift/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ledger-evidence-drift`
- [ ] Maintainer replay from a clean checkout
